name: EndeavorRx
short_description: FDA-approved prescription video game digital therapeutic for pediatric ADHD that improves attention function through engaging sensory stimuli and motor challenges.
long_description: EndeavorRx is the first FDA-approved prescription treatment delivered through a video game, designed for children ages 8-17 with inattentive or combined-type ADHD. Created by world-class neuroscientists and award-winning game designers, the digital therapeutic uses sensory stimuli and motor challenges to target brain areas key to attention function. Kids are challenged to multitask and ignore distractions by navigating courses, collecting targets, and avoiding obstacles. The treatment protocol involves 25 minutes of play per day, 5 days a week, for 4 weeks. In clinical trials with over 600 children, roughly half of parents reported clinically meaningful improvement in their child's daily impairments after one month.
one_liner: FDA-approved video game treatment for pediatric ADHD
best_for: and developmental pediatricians treating children ages 8-17 with ADHD who may benefit from non-pharmacological attention training
not_for: Practices not treating pediatric ADHD patients

faqs.a: EndeavorRx is the first FDA-approved prescription treatment delivered through a video game, designed for children ages 8-17 with inattentive or combined-type ADHD to improve attention function.

The game uses sensory stimuli and motor challenges to target brain areas key to attention. Kids navigate courses, collect targets, and avoid obstacles while being challenged to multitask and ignore distractions.

faqs.q: What is the EndeavorRx treatment protocol?
faqs.a: Children play for 25 minutes per day, 5 days per week, for 4 weeks. Clinical trials showed roughly half of parents reported clinically meaningful improvement after one month.

faqs.q: What ages is EndeavorRx approved for?
faqs.a: EndeavorRx was initially approved for ages 8-12 and has been expanded by the FDA to include adolescents ages 13-17 with ADHD.
